title: Patch: a Show card text button on the Almanac and Statistics pages, and a hover text box on their cards
notes: Issue #3838: the Almanac and the Statistics page gain a Show card text button (routes/cardText.tsx) that prints every face on the page as its normal face, its words on it, with no full art (FullArtAllowed false), kept on the device and shared by both pages, never writing the Full-art cards setting (R3838000). On the Almanac every grid card with words opens the hover preview with its Full text panel (AlwaysFullText, Extended.tsx; R3838001), and a reference's tooltip has its card's whole text beside its face where the face prints less or below AlwaysFullText (CardRef.tsx, placement.ts refTooltipSize; R3838002). How cards play is unchanged.

player.title: Readable cards in the Almanac
new: The Almanac and the Statistics page have a Show card text button that turns full art off there, so every card prints its text.
Hovering a card in the Almanac shows its full text beside it, and so does hovering a card its text names.
